analysis.session_summary: AUD crashed after RBA held rates at 4.85% inline but the press conference signaled uncertainty; AUD strength finished -0.384%. CHF, CAD, and NZD led while USD saw an early safe-haven bid from a US strike on Iran that partly faded. EUR and GBP were little changed, leaving EUR as the weakest behind AUD. Risk gauges pushed higher with VIX up 6.278% to 20.739, and high-beta crosses underperformed.

themes.evidence: AUD strength -0.384%; Cash Rate inline but AUD fell 0.251%; RBA Press Conference added -0.093%; AUD/USD -31.2 pips; AUD/CHF -28.3 pips.
US Military Launched An Undisclosed Strike Against Iran's Qeshm Island headline; VIX +6.278% to 20.739; USD/ZAR +387.4 pips; USD/MXN +445.9 pips; Gold/USD final leg -397.1 pips.

currency_drivers.USD: No US data; early safe-haven bid from Iran strike faded, leaving USD modestly higher.
currency_drivers.EUR: No euro-area catalyst; drifted lower within its range and closed near flat.
currency_drivers.JPY: No Japanese catalyst; early haven demand faded, leaving only a small gain.
currency_drivers.GBP: No UK catalyst; held its range with minor gains.
currency_drivers.AUD: RBA held in line but press conference uncertainty drove a large selloff.
currency_drivers.CAD: No Canadian catalyst; strengthened without a clear domestic driver.
currency_drivers.CHF: No Swiss catalyst; led the board higher with no clear domestic trigger.
currency_drivers.NZD: No clear NZD catalyst; strength came as AUD fell sharply, not from own data.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD alternated down/up/down/up across the overnight window, with the final up leg helped by RBA statement, closing -12.2 pips.

polarity_reads.read: Inline at 4.85% was not enough to support AUD; the -0.251% impulse shows longs were crowded and sensitive to any dovish hint.
Unscored because no forecast, but AUD fell another 0.093%; the market treated the lack of hawkish guidance as negative.

scenarios.name: Risk stabilization with AUD heavy
scenarios.thesis: RBA uncertainty keeps AUD under pressure while havens fade slightly; no escalation in Iran and US election not yet resolved.
scenarios.invalidation: US election outcome triggers sudden risk-off; AUD/USD breaks above 0.69794 with strong momentum.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR soft (-0.048) and USD firm (+0.062), within overnight range 29.3 pips.
AUD weakest at -0.384; range 41.8 pips, RBA uncertainty persists.
USD firm but risk stabilized; range 18.8 pips.

scenarios.name: Geopolitical escalation / risk-off
scenarios.thesis: US-Iran tensions escalate or US election triggers haven demand, boosting CHF, JPY and USD while AUD and high-beta stay weak.
triggers: Further US military action against Iran
scenarios.invalidation: VIX reverses the 6.278% rise; AUD/USD recovers above 0.69794.

scenarios.name: Risk-on mean reversion
scenarios.thesis: Markets fade the RBA selloff and geopolitical premium, allowing AUD and NZD to bounce.
scenarios.invalidation: AUD/USD fails to hold above 0.69794; RBA guidance turns even more dovish.

pair_paths.rationale: NZD strength +0.096 and risk-on supports; range 27.4 pips.

risks.why_it_matters: AUD already -0.384; if market reassesses rate path, AUD crosses can fall further.
High impact at 16:16; can swing USD and risk appetite.
CHF +0.107 led board; if risk mood turns, it can reverse sharply.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: CHF CPI at 08:30 may extend CHF strength; US JOLTS at 16:00 and Congressional Elections at 16:16 drive USD and risk; BOC Gov Macklem at 17:00 may move CAD.
